purpose: Replace physical clause-family materialization with an exact shared Boolean-expression DAG and test whether the strongest exposed R17 resource wall can be compiled without enumerating a huge width-3 clause basis.

representation_contract.name: HASHCONS_AND_OR_DAG_WITH_SHANNON_EXISTENTIAL_QUANTIFICATION
must_preserve: exact Boolean function over the remaining variables
existence of an extension for every bridge assignment
must_destroy_or_ignore: dead unreachable nodes after each quantified variable
canonicalization: hash-cons nodes by exact structural content
detect literal/complement pairs inside one AND/OR node
after every quantified variable rebuild only the reachable DAG
representation_contract.elimination_order: Compute direct.occurrence_order on the original frozen frame once; filter to original internal variables; never adapt order using truth or verifier feedback.
representation_contract.verifier: Only after candidate terminal: independent Minisat22 on original frame across all 2^9 bridge assignments; candidate DAG is evaluated directly on the same bridge assignments; all original SAT models replayed.

success_gate: final DAG support is a subset of the 9 frozen bridge variables
candidate never invokes a SAT/search oracle
complete 512-assignment bridge domain matches the independent original-frame verifier with FP=0 and FN=0

failure_or_open_semantics.semantic_mismatch: freeze R18 candidate as failed discovery
failure_or_open_semantics.resource_limit: OPEN_RESOURCE_LIMIT; do not infer semantic failure

promotion_rule: Only exact exposed-W04 MATCH within the frozen envelope authorizes byte-freezing the R18 candidate for post-discovery semantic controls on R16-W05..W08. Those controls still are not a fresh unseen generalization set because their structures were exposed in R16.
claim_ceiling: Even a perfect W04 result only demonstrates an exact compact representation/quantification mechanism on one exposed resource-wall world. It does not establish polynomial scaling, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
